package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gorm_hook_mutates_unrelated_tables: Hooks that reach beyond the owning aggregate and write unrelated records.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Rule059PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}
type Rule059AuditLog struct {
	ID      int
	Action  string
	Table   string
	RecordID int
}

func (u *Rule059PositiveRecord) AfterCreate(tx *gorm.DB) error {
	log := Rule059AuditLog{
		Action:   "create",
		Table:    "rule_059_positive_records",
		RecordID: u.ID,
	}
	return tx.Create(&log).Error
}
